tools.name: lookup_scholar_status
tools.description: Look up the current dismissal status of one specific scholar by student ID or by full name — their homeroom section, whether they are being held after dismissal, the hold type, the release time, and the location to collect them. Use this tool when someone asks about one scholar. Do not use it to list or compare multiple scholars. Returns the scholar’s status, or a clear explanation of why the status cannot be answered right now.

tools.name: search_roster
tools.description: List the scholars on today’s dismissal roster, optionally narrowed by homeroom section, hold type, or attendance status. Use this tool when someone asks for a group — a whole roster, a section, or everyone with a given hold. Do not use it to look up one specific scholar. Returns a page of scholars with the total match count; the result can be paged.

tools.name: roster_sync_status
tools.description: Check the health of the roster data feed: when the roster was last refreshed, whether it is current, and how many rows were quarantined with the reasons. Requires an administrative role. Use this tool to diagnose why dismissal-status answers might be stale or incomplete.

tools.name: create_pickup_request
tools.description: Record a new early-pickup request for one scholar — the student ID, the pickup time, and the reason category — and route it to the approver responsible for that scholar. Use this tool when a parent calls the school in the morning to schedule a pickup later today. Do not use it to look up an existing request, to review a queue of requests, or to record a decision.

tools.name: list_pending_approvals
tools.description: List the early-pickup requests waiting for YOUR decision today — each request routed to you as the approver, with the scholar, the pickup time, the reason category, and how far it has climbed the escalation ladder. Use this tool when an approver asks what is pending for them right now. Do not use it to create a request, to look up a scholar’s dismissal status, or to decide.

tools.name: decide_pickup_request
tools.description: Record a decision on an early-pickup request — approve it, flag it for a closer look, or deny it — with an optional note explaining the decision. Use this tool when an approver has reviewed a pending request and made a call. Do not use it to create requests, to list what is pending, or to look up a scholar’s dismissal status.

tools.name: record_pickup_outcome
tools.description: Record the outcome of an approved early pickup — that the scholar was released to their pickup person, or that a released pickup was completed. Use this tool when the front office hands the scholar over. Do not use it to approve or deny a request, to create one, or to look up a scholar’s dismissal status.
